entries.title: Jeremiah 45:1
segments: ¶The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 45:2
segments: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch;

entries.title: Jeremiah 45:3
segments: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.

words.text: is me now! for the LORD

entries.title: Jeremiah 45:4
segments: Thus shalt thou say unto him, The LORD saith thus; Behold, [that] which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.

words.text: thus; Behold, [that] which I have built
, and that which I have planted

entries.title: Jeremiah 45:5
segments: And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek [them] not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the LORD: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.

words.text: [them] not: for, behold, I will bring
